text_en: After the sabbath, as the first day of the week was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
text_cn: 安息日既过，一周的第一日，天快亮时，玛利亚玛达肋纳和另外一个玛利亚来看坟墓。

text_en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord, descending from heaven, came and rolled back the stone and sat on it.
text_cn: 忽然发生了大地震，因为上主的天使从天降来，上前把石头滚开，坐在上面。

text_en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
text_cn: 他的容貌好像闪电，他的衣服洁白如雪。

text_en: For fear of him the guards shook and became like dead men.
text_cn: 看守的人由于怕他，吓得打颤，变得好像死人一样。

text_en: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid; I know that you are looking for Jesus who was crucified.
text_cn: 天使对妇女说道：“你们不要害怕！我知道你们寻找被钉死的耶稣。

text_en: He is not here; for he has been raised, as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.
text_cn: 他不在这里，因为他已经照他所说的复活了。你们来看看那安放过他的地方；

text_en: Then go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has been raised from the dead, and indeed he is going ahead of you to Galilee; there you will see him. ’ This is my message for you. ”
text_cn: 并且快去对他的门徒说：他已经由死者中复活了。看！他在你们以先往加里肋亚去，在那里你们要看见他。看！我已经告诉了你们。”

text_en: So they left the tomb quickly with fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
text_cn: 她们赶快离开坟墓，又恐惧又异常喜乐，跑去报告他的门徒。

text_en: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings! ” And they came to him, took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
text_cn: 忽然，耶稣迎上她们说：“愿你们平安！”她们遂上前抱住耶稣的脚，朝拜了他。

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid; go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对她们说：“不要害怕！你们去，报告我的兄弟，叫他们往加里肋亚去，他们要在那里看见我。”

text_en: While they were going, some of the guard went into the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.
text_cn: 当妇女离去的时候，有几个看守的兵士来到城里，把所发生的事，全告诉了司祭长。

text_en: After the priests had assembled with the elders, they devised a plan to give a large sum of money to the soldiers,
text_cn: 司祭长就同长老聚会商议之后，给了兵士许多钱，

text_en: telling them, “You must say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were asleep. ’
text_cn: 嘱咐他们说：“你们就说：我们睡觉的时候，他的门徒夜间来了，把他偷去了。

text_en: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble. ”
text_cn: 如果这事为总督听见，有我们说好话，保管你们无事。”

text_en: So they took the money and did as they were directed. And this story is still told among the Jews to this day.
text_cn: 兵士拿了银钱，就照他们所嘱咐的做了。这消息在犹太人间传扬开了，一直到今天。

text_en: Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain to which Jesus had directed them.
text_cn: 十一个门徒就往加里肋亚，到耶稣给他们所指定的山上去了。

text_en: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.
text_cn: 他们一看见他，就朝拜了他，虽然有人还心中疑惑。

text_en: And Jesus came and said to them, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
text_cn: 耶稣便上前对他们说：“天上地下的一切权柄都交给了我，

text_en: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
text_cn: 所以你们要去使万民成为门徒，因父及子及圣神之名给他们授洗，

text_en: and teaching them to obey everything that I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age. ”
text_cn: 教训他们遵守我所吩咐你们的一切。看！我同你们天天在一起，直到今世的终结。”
